title: Scoped negative: PR589 A-triple fixed single-move options (210 cases)
body:
## Scoped negative result

This is an exact census of the Cartesian product of three fixed, individually legal single-move option lists for the seed-selected simultaneous A-operation triple `(927, 928, 930)` in the selected PR589 `v=111`, `R=439` word. It covers exactly `7 × 6 × 5 = 210` combinations from those lists; it does not claim completeness over jointly enabled frames, commutation options, or every legal triple placement.

The three operations write register 325 at frame 282 from sources 256, 442 and 392. Of the 210 combinations, 46 fail full register-chain nesting, 100 valid assignments preserve the baseline paid profile, and 64 valid assignments yield the same strictly higher-cost profile. There are no improvements or unresolved cases. This is a scoped negative result; it claims no new `κ` or supplier admission.

Commit [`948f8f5`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/948f8f5) restricts the census claim to precisely these fixed option lists and the verified 210 combinations.

## Reproduction

From the repository root (verified with CPython 3.14.7):

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit589-shared-register-triple-seed05/verify.py
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_PR589_A_TRIPLE_TRANSPORT seed=5 ops=927,928,930 assignments=210 valid=164 ties=100 losses=64 incompatible=46 controls=3 no_new_kappa
```

The package pins base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`, the selected PR589 word and bit cost, and PR1345 atlas head `b54a856aa79857d91cd5d65f8f7144e26c8c084f`. The PR1345 transport atlas is credited and vendored under its repository license. PR #1382 is a distinct A/B cross-section pair census.

The census concerns only this triple and these fixed option lists. Other triples, larger move sets, structural changes, and alternate suppliers remain outside its conclusion; the inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, and analytic assumptions remain. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for task selection, enumeration, verification, and writing. No independent human review or subagents are claimed.
